text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 1. MATERIAL: FR-4 glass-epoxy laminate, NO COPPER on any layer (unclad or fully etched): a mechanical plate, not a circuit. FINISHED THICKNESS OVER THE SOLDER MASK 0.8 +-0.1 mm.
Choose the laminate for that finished thickness and state the build-up in the quote (a 0.8 mm copper-clad laminate ends near 0.75 without its copper). We use plates from 0.76 to 0.90 mm.

2. SOLDER MASK: matte black, both faces, full coverage EXCEPT a round relief Ø1.25 at each hole T1 on both faces: no mask on the hole wall or rim (or drill after mask). LEGEND on the underside only: sheet 2. No date code.
3. OUTLINE AND CUT-OUTS: routed, +-0.1. No V-score. Supply individually routed pieces. If panelised: break-off tabs ONLY on the flat (y = 18.25), mouse bites recessed into the outline by at most
0.25 mm, no nub proud of the outline anywhere. NO tab on the round part: it drops into a bore with 0.25 mm radial clearance and carries a 0.4 mm seal land.

4. HOLES T1: 3 x Ø1.1 +-0.05, drilled, non-plated, free of mask; position +-0.05 to each other, +-0.1 to the outline. They take Ø1.0 balls of 316 stainless (grade 100 or better) or silicon nitride, never 440C (E8; detail, for information).
5. CORNERS: slot ends full radius R1.1; no internal corner below R0.5. The two external corners at the ends of the flat are sharp (break edge 0.1 max).
6. FLATNESS: bow and twist 0.5 % maximum (0.2 mm over the part). Edges free of burrs and loose fibres. Both faces are bonding faces: no release agent, mask fully cured, parts clean.

7. DATA (mm, same origin): drawings/fab/GL1-011_base_plate_FR4-Profile.gbr (Gerber: outline + routed cut-outs), F_Mask.gbr / B_Mask.gbr (mask), B_Legend.gbr (legend, sheet 2), NPTH.drl (Excellon, NPTH);
8. Datum: origin = centre of the R21.75 arc; +x to the right and +y toward the flat in this view (seen on the top face). The part is symmetric about the y axis.

9. To report with the first articles: thickness over the mask, hole diameters, outline. PROVISIONAL - not released. Nominal CAD dimensions (design/master_params.yaml rev D); checked by check 15 of the build.
